era: 1828-1906 : 1828 生于挪威希恩小镇木材商家庭——8 岁家道中落、父亲破产，'体面人家的崩塌'成为他一生的原始创伤与戏剧母题——16 岁到格里姆斯塔当药店学徒，写诗自励，私生子事件伴随其青年时代——1850 赴奥斯陆（克里斯蒂安尼亚）考大学失败，转而进入剧场：在卑尔根挪威剧院任驻团编剧与导演（1851-1857，每年必须交出剧本，剧场强迫他学会舞台的全部机械——这所'剧场大学'教他的比任何学院都多）——1858 任克里斯蒂安尼亚挪威剧院艺术总监——1864 普丹战争爆发，挪威袖手旁观，他对祖国的犬儒与怯懦彻底失望，终身自我流放（罗马—德累斯顿—慕尼黑，侨居 27 年）——民族浪漫主义时期的《布朗德》(1866)《培尔·金特》(1867) 以诗剧把挪威人的精神标本钉上解剖台，令他成为民族诗人却身处异国——1877 起转向散文'社会问题剧'：《社会支柱》(1877)《玩偶之家》(1879)《群鬼》(1881)《人民公敌》(1882)——每部都引发全欧丑闻，《玩偶之家》1879 年柏林首演后'娜拉'成为欧洲家庭变革的口号；《群鬼》被骂为'敞开的阴沟'却是最早公开书写梅毒与遗传道德病的作品——1884《野鸭》转向'生活谎言'的心理解剖，1890《海达·高布乐》把潜台词艺术推到极致——晚年自反三部曲《建筑大师》(1892)《小艾友夫》(1894)《当我们死人醒来时》(1899) 把解剖刀转向自己的艺术与自负——1900 中风，1906 逝世；临终护士说他'今天好些了'，他答'恰恰相反'——一生 26 部剧作，被称为'现代戏剧之父'，问题剧、潜台词、象征道具、开放式结尾四大发明至今仍是戏剧的语法
era_en: 1828-1906 : born 1828 in Skien, Norway, to a timber-merchant family—his father's bankruptcy when he was eight, the collapse of a respectable household, became his primal wound and dramatic theme - at sixteen apprenticed to a pharmacy in Grimstad, writing verse, shadowed by a paternity suit - 1850, failed the university entrance exams in Christiania and entered the theatre instead: resident playwright and stage director at the Norwegian Theatre in Bergen (1851-57, obliged to deliver a script every year—the theatre's workshop schooling in stagecraft taught him more than any academy) - 1858, artistic director of the Christiania Norwegian Theatre - 1864, the Dano-Prussian War broke out and Norway stood aside; disgusted by his country's cynicism he went into lifelong self-exile (Rome, Dresden, Munich—twenty-seven years abroad) - the verse plays Brand (1866) and Peer Gynt (1867) pinned the Norwegian spirit to the dissecting table and made him the national poet while living abroad - from 1877 the prose 'problem plays': Pillars of Society (1877), A Doll's House (1879), Ghosts (1881), An Enemy of the People (1882)—each a European scandal; Nora became a slogan for household reform, and Ghosts, denounced as 'an open drain,' was among the first works to write openly about syphilis and hereditary moral disease - The Wild Duck (1884) turned to psychological anatomy of the 'life-lie'; Hedda Gabler (1890) carried subtext to its highest pitch - the late self-reckoning plays The Master Builder (1892), Little Eyolf (1894), When We Dead Awaken (1899) turned the scalpel on his own art and vanity - stroke in 1900, died 1906; told by his nurse that he seemed better, he answered 'on the contrary' - twenty-six plays; called the father of modern drama, his four inventions—problem play, subtext, symbolic prop, and the open ending—are still the grammar of theatre
school: 现代戏剧之父 / 社会问题剧（problem play）的创立者 / 心理写实主义与潜台词戏剧的奠基人 / 挪威'理想主义—解剖主义'文学传统的宗师（影响了萧伯纳、契诃夫、斯特林堡、乔伊斯与整个现代主义戏剧）
historical_significance: 易卜生（1828-1906），挪威剧作家，'现代戏剧之父'，他的历史地位由四个发明锚定。其一，问题剧：1877-1882 五年间他连发《社会支柱》《玩偶之家》《群鬼》《人民公敌》，第一次把当下的社会问题（妇女地位、婚姻谎言、遗传病、多数暴政）放进市民客厅而非神话宫殿，戏剧从'消遣'变成'审判'，萧伯纳因此称他'把舞台变成了法庭'。其二，潜台词：他把人物真正想说的藏在台词之下，用停顿、眼神、道具的位移说话——契诃夫与斯特林堡都承认这一遗产，现代影视的'冰山对话'皆源于此。其三，象征道具：《野鸭》的野鸭、《建筑大师》的高塔、《玩偶之家》的信箱——让观众绕过说教直接触摸主题的实体。其四，结构性的回溯与开放结尾：《群鬼》与《海达》把'过去'作为现在时的病灶逐层掘开，《玩偶之家》的关门声被称作'震撼欧洲的门响'，结局第一次不再闭合问题而是打开问题。他的勇气同样重要：在 1880 年代写出梅毒、《玩偶之家》写出女人'首先是人'，全欧齐骂之际他答'我写的是全人类'——这句自我辩护正是他方法论的钥匙：解剖得越具体，意义越普遍。代价与张力同样真实：他对家庭完全失职（弃私生子于不顾、对妻子近乎冷漠）；他自夸'每一部新作都否定前一部'，晚年陷入自我解剖的封闭；《人民公敌》式的孤胆先知姿态后来被滥用为反民主的修辞。但方法论遗产极其清晰：一个文明的病灶不在广场而在客厅，真正的戏剧性不是事件而是'被掩盖的过去如何在现在发作'——这使他与马克思、弗洛伊德并列为十九世纪给二十世纪'揭盖子'的三位大师。
historical_significance_en: Henrik Ibsen (1828-1906), Norwegian playwright, the father of modern drama, whose standing rests on four inventions. First, the problem play: between 1877 and 1882 he issued Pillars of Society, A Doll's House, Ghosts, and An Enemy of the People, putting the social questions of the day—women's status, the marriage lie, hereditary disease, the tyranny of the majority—into bourgeois drawing rooms instead of mythic palaces, turning drama from entertainment into trial; Shaw said he made the stage a court of law. Second, subtext: he buried what characters truly mean beneath their lines, letting pauses, glances, and the displacement of objects speak—Chekhov and Strindberg acknowledged the legacy, and every modern 'iceberg dialogue' on film descends from it. Third, the symbolic prop: the wild duck, the tower in The Master Builder, the letterbox in A Doll's House—concrete objects that let the audience touch the theme past all sermon. Fourth, structural retrospection and the open ending: Ghosts and Hedda Gabler excavate the past as the pathology of the present, and the door slam of A Doll's House, said to have shaken Europe like a pistol shot, was the first ending that opens a question instead of closing one. His courage mattered equally: writing about syphilis in the 1880s, about a woman who is 'first and foremost a human being'—and when all Europe howled, he answered 'I am writing about all humanity,' the very key to his method: the more concrete the dissection, the more universal the meaning. The tensions were real: he was wholly derelict as a father and nearly cold as a husband; he boasted that each new play negates the last, closing his late years into self-dissection; and the lone-prophet posture of An Enemy of the People was later abused as anti-democratic rhetoric. Yet the methodological legacy is crisp: a civilization's pathology lives not in the square but in the parlor, and true drama is not event but 'the buried past erupting into the present'—which sets him beside Marx and Freud as one of the three nineteenth-century masters of lifting the lid for the twentieth.
unique_thinking: 他的思维方式的底色是'把家庭客厅当作文明的切片，把过去当作现在时的病灶'：易卜生的一生是一部'剧作家如何解剖一个社会'的教程。五个标志性动作：其一，'回溯式解剖'——他不写事件的发生而写事件的清查：《群鬼》开场只是例行登记，《玩偶之家》开场只是过节借钱，戏剧的全部动力是把'过去发生了什么'一层层掘出来——真相不是高潮而是矿脉；其二，'谎言病理学'——《野鸭》的伟大倒转：一般认为谎言是病，易卜生诊断出'说出全部真相'也可能是病（瑞凌医生强行揭穿生活谎言而毁了孩子），真理主义者与谎言供养者的双向病理，比陀思妥耶夫斯基的同题讨论更早也更冷峻；其三，'多数即谬误'——《人民公敌》从字面倒转民主公式的方向：小镇最大的污染不是矿泉的细菌而是'多数人'的既得利益，少数说真话者被投票表决为'人民公敌'——这是对舆论暴政最早的戏剧化实验报告；其四，'潜台词工程'——他要求演员'读每句话下面的意思'：台词说天气，戏在说婚姻；台词斟酌酒杯，戏在斟酌自杀——意义被系统性地移出明文、藏进物件与停顿，这是把'不可言说之物'变成可导演之物的工程学；其五，'出走作为论证'——《玩偶之家》的结尾没有和解没有死亡，只有一声关门：娜拉的出走不是情节的解决而是论证的完成（'首先我是一个人'）——他用一个动作把问题的不解决本身写成了答案。代价与极限：他的解剖靠'外来者/归来者'作手术刀（娜拉走后去哪里、《群鬼》的欧士华从巴黎归来），这使他的社会处方常停在诊断而少于建设；《人民公敌》的姿态易被民粹与反民主修辞挪用；而他对身边人（妻子、私生子、儿子）的冷漠是他作品'普遍人性'声明的最痛注脚。他晚年的自我总结是'写作就是站在法官面前自审'——但他真正的天才在于：把戏剧从'讲故事'改造成'做病理报告'，让每个时代的观众在客厅里认出自己的病灶。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of his thinking was 'treating the drawing room as a cross-section of civilization and the past as the pathology of the present': Ibsen's life is a tutorial on how a playwright dissects a society. Five signature moves. First, retrospective anatomy: he does not write the event but the investigation of the event—Ghosts opens as routine registration, A Doll's House as holiday borrowing; the play's whole engine is digging up 'what happened back then,' truth delivered not as climax but as ore vein. Second, the pathology of the lie: The Wild Duck's great inversion—where lying is normally the disease, Ibsen diagnoses 'telling the whole truth' as disease too (Relling's forced exposure of the life-lie destroys the child), a double pathology of truth-fanatic and lie-sustainer, earlier and colder than Dostoevsky's treatment of the theme. Third, majority as error: An Enemy of the People literally reverses the democratic formula—the town's worst pollution is not the spa's bacteria but the vested interest of 'the majority,' and the truth-teller is voted the people's enemy—the earliest dramatized experiment report on the tyranny of opinion. Fourth, the engineering of subtext: he instructed actors to 'read beneath every line'—the words discuss the weather while the play discusses the marriage; the words weigh a wine glass while the play weighs suicide—meaning systematically moved out of the text into objects and pauses, an engineering for making the unsayable directable. Fifth, departure as argument: the ending of A Doll's House offers no reconciliation and no death, only a door slam—Nora's exit is not a plot resolution but the completion of an argument ('first and foremost I am a human being'); he writes the non-resolution of the question as the answer. The limits: his dissection always needs the outsider or returnee as scalpel (where Nora goes after leaving, Oswald returning from Paris), so his social prescriptions stop at diagnosis and rarely build; the Enemy-of-the-People posture is easily appropriated by populist and anti-democratic rhetoric; and his coldness to wife, illegitimate son, and living son is the most painful footnote to his declaration of 'universal humanity.' His late self-summary: 'to write is to sit in judgment on oneself.' But his true genius was to rebuild drama from storytelling into pathology reporting—to make every generation's audience recognize its own lesion in a parlor.

modes.domain_zh: 1881《群鬼》：开场只是阿尔文太太为孤儿院办理登记的例行公事——但随着曼德斯牧师、吕嘉纳、欧士华逐一登场，一个三十年前的婚姻骗局、一次被劝阻的出走、一场遗传的梅毒被逐层掘出；全剧没有'事件'，只有对过去的法医学清查，最后一夜欧士华在黎明中喊出'太阳，太阳'——病灶全部来自'回不去的过去'。这是易卜生把古希腊'命运悲剧'改造成'记忆悲剧'的技术枢纽
modes.domain_en: Ghosts (1881): the opening is nothing but Mrs. Alving's routine registration of an orphanage—yet as Pastor Manders, Regina, and Oswald enter one by one, a thirty-year-old marriage fraud, a discouraged flight, and an inherited syphilis are dug out layer by layer; the play contains no 'event,' only a forensic inquest into the past, ending with Oswald crying 'the sun, the sun' at dawn—the lesion lies wholly in an unrecoverable past. This was Ibsen's technical hinge that remade Greek fate-tragedy into tragedy of memory
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生回溯解剖法的核心命题是：戏剧性的最大矿藏在'已经发生的事'里，而不在'正在发生的事'里。常规叙事把动力放在未来（悬念：接下来会怎样）；易卜生把动力放在过去（追问：当初到底发生了什么）。三步操作。第一步，表层正常化：开场呈现一个表面平静或例行公事的场景（过节、登记、开业典礼），让病灶完全沉在水下。第二步，探针序列：安排一个或多个'探针人物'（归来者、外来者、追问者），他们的每个问题与每次要求，都会撬开过去的一层——层层递进，每层比上层更痛。第三步，现在时发作：清查的终点是发现过去从未过去——它以病症、债务、遗传、身份的形式正在发作；观众在最后一幕才看清：全剧讨论的其实是三十年前的事。深意有三重。其一，这把'真相'从结局的奖品改造成过程的矿脉——观众与人物一起挖掘，戏剧变成集体侦查。其二，它颠倒了'过去已完成'的常识：在易卜生这里，过去是现在时的进行式——凡是没被直面过的过去，都在以更高的利息现在支付。其三，它与弗洛伊德的精神分析同年诞生、同构生成——症状即被压抑者的回归，舞台即诊室。适用边界：适合创伤、制度积弊、家族秘密等'深度在时间中'的题材；对纯粹当下的行动冲突（球赛、战争直播）传统顺叙反而更经济。现代对应物：纪录片的'调查式叙事'、非虚构写作的'倒叙侦查结构'、精神分析、审计与事故调查报告、企业尽调的'从现状回溯交易史'。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's retrospective-anatomy method: the richest ore of drama lies in 'what has already happened,' not 'what is happening.' Conventional narrative puts its engine in the future (suspense: what next?); Ibsen puts it in the past (the question: what really happened then?). Three steps. First, normalize the surface: open on a scene of calm or routine (a holiday, a registration, an opening ceremony), the pathology wholly submerged. Second, the probe sequence: introduce one or more probe figures—the returnee, the outsider, the questioner—whose every question pries open another layer of the past, each layer deeper and more painful than the last. Third, eruption in the present tense: the inquest ends in discovering that the past never passed—it erupts now as symptom, debt, inheritance, identity; only in the final act does the audience see that the play has been about something thirty years old. Three layers of depth. First, truth is re-made from the prize at the end into the vein in the middle—audience and characters dig together, the play a collective inquest. Second, it inverts the notion that the past is finished: in Ibsen the past is present progressive—whatever was never faced is now paid at compounding interest. Third, it is coeval and isomorphic with Freudian psychoanalysis—the symptom as the return of the repressed, the stage as consulting room. Boundaries: it suits material whose depth lies in time—trauma, institutional rot, family secrets; for purely present-tense action (a match, a live war) linear telling is more economical. Modern counterparts: investigative documentary structure, nonfiction's backwards inquest, psychoanalysis, audit and accident-investigation reports, due diligence that traces present state back through transaction history.

modes.key_quote_zh: 戏不在即将发生的事里，戏在当年被埋下的那件事里——掘开它，全场的灯才亮。
modes.key_quote_en: The play is not in what is about to happen—the play is in what was buried years ago; dig it out, and the whole stage lights up.
process_zh: 表层定妆：选择一个表面平静、例行公事的开场场景，让全部病灶沉在水下——不给任何预告
设定探针：安排归来者/外来者/追问者作为手术刀人物，其存在本身就是对平衡的威胁
层进清查：每个探针行动撬开过去一层，层与层之间严格递进——每层比上层更接近病灶核心
证据显形：让过去以物件（信、账本、病历、遗嘱）而非口供的形式显形——物证比台词更锋利
现在发作：清查终点不是'知道了'而是'发作了'——过去以病症/债务/身份的形式当场兑现
留白收尾：不解释病灶的解法，让观众带着未闭合的诊断离场
process_en: Set the surface: open on calm, routine normality with the pathology wholly submerged—no previews given
Plant the probe: install the returnee, outsider, or questioner as the scalpel figure whose very presence threatens the equilibrium
Layer the inquest: each probe action pries open one layer of the past, strictly escalating—each layer nearer the lesion's core
Surface the evidence: let the past appear as objects (letters, ledgers, case files, wills) rather than confession—physical evidence cuts sharper than lines
Erupt in the present: the inquest ends not in 'knowing' but in eruption—the past cashing out on stage as symptom, debt, identity
Close with the open wound: explain no remedy; send the audience off carrying an unclosed diagnosis
representative_cases_zh: 《群鬼》清查（1881）：从孤儿院登记开始，三十年前的婚姻骗局被一信一病逐层掘出——全剧零'事件'，全靠回溯，成为'记忆悲剧'的教科书
《玩偶之家》借据线（1879）：开场是圣诞节借钱买东西的温馨琐事，那张藏在信箱里的借据是三十年诚信问题在一桩小债务上的浓缩发作
《海达·高布乐》遗稿线（1890）： Lovborg 的遗稿与毁稿构成全剧的探针——海达的过去与别人的未来在一场书房火灾里对质
《建筑大师》顶楼线（1892）：索尔尼斯不敢单独上顶楼——开场的恐惧是十年前烧毁的房子与死去的女儿，全剧向上爬的每一步都是对那场火灾的清查
representative_cases_en: The Ghosts inquest (1881): from an orphanage registration, a thirty-year-old marriage fraud is dug out through one letter and one disease—zero 'events,' all retrospection, the textbook of memory-tragedy
The Doll's House loan (1879): the opening is cozy Christmas borrowing; the promissory note waiting in the letterbox is a thirty-year problem of integrity erupting in one small debt
The Hedda manuscript (1890): Lövborg's lost and burned manuscript is the play's probe—Hedda's past and another's future confronting in a study fire
The Master Builder's tower (1892): Solness dares not climb alone—the opening fear is a burned house and a dead daughter ten years old; every step up the tower is an inquest into that fire
modern_applications_zh: 事故调查与审计：不问'接下来怎么办'先问'当初怎么埋的雷'——从现状倒查决策史（账目、邮件、会议纪要），把'过去从未过去'写成调查报告的第一原则
心理咨询与教练：来访者的'当下困扰'多数是未结案的过去——咨询结构本身就是回溯式清查：表层陈述→探针提问→创伤发作→未闭合收尾
企业尽调与并购：从财务异常回溯交易史——每张异常凭证都是一封信箱里的借据，尽调报告的读者就是最后一幕才明白全局的观众
内容创作：短视频与专栏的'倒叙钩子'——开场即结果（表面正常），全程回答'怎么会这样'，完播率来自清查动力而非悬念
modern_applications_en: Accident investigation and audit: not 'what next' but 'how was the mine laid'—trace present state back through decision history (ledgers, emails, minutes); 'the past never passed' as the report's first principle
Coaching and counseling: most present-tense distress is an unclosed past—the session itself is a retrospective inquest: surface account, probe questions, eruption, unclosed close

Due diligence and M&A: from financial anomalies back through transaction history—every odd voucher is a promissory note in a letterbox; the report's reader is the audience who sees the whole only in the last act
Content craft: the backwards hook of short video and columns—open on the outcome (surface normal), answer 'how did it come to this' throughout; retention comes from inquest drive, not suspense

representative_figures.relation_zh: 《俄狄浦斯王》的'追查即剧情'结构——易卜生回溯解剖法的两千年前原型，把神谕换成信箱与病历
representative_figures.relation_en: Oedipus Rex's 'the investigation is the plot'—the two-thousand-year prototype of Ibsen's retrospective anatomy, oracle exchanged for letterbox and case file

representative_figures.relation_zh: 直接承认易卜生遗产的继承者——把回溯与潜台词稀释进气氛，《樱桃园》的旧债与旧物是《群鬼》技法的抒情变奏
representative_figures.relation_en: the direct acknowledged heir—diluting retrospection and subtext into atmosphere; the old debts and old objects of The Cherry Orchard are a lyric variation on Ghosts' technique

representative_figures.relation_zh: 《推销员之死》把回溯解剖推回美国客厅——威利的过去与现在同台发作，自称'易卜生主义者'
representative_figures.relation_en: Death of a Salesman carried retrospective anatomy back into an American parlor—Willy's past erupting onstage with his present; Miller called himself an Ibsenite

name_zh: 表达方法论/把真正想说的系统性移出明文、藏进停顿、物件与语气——台词说天气，戏在说婚姻；让不可言说之物变得可导演
name_en: expression methodology/systematically moving what one truly means out of the text into pauses, objects, and intonation—the words discuss the weather while the play discusses the marriage; making the unsayable directable
category: 表达方法论/把真正想说的系统性移出明文、藏进停顿、物件与语气——台词说天气，戏在说婚姻；让不可言说之物变得可导演
modes.domain_zh: 1890《海达·高布乐》：全剧最致命的动作没有一句台词——海达翻开乐世博的遗稿说'这真是不可饶恕'、把枪交给'世界上最美丽的死法'，台词全是客厅礼貌，动作全是谋杀与情欲；第二幕她一句'把手臂枕着睡会痛'（对自己的旧情），说的其实是她全部婚姻的病。易卜生对演员的指令——'读每一句话下面的意思'——把对话拆成两层：明文（社交层）与潜文（真实层），戏剧张力来自两层之间的落差
modes.domain_en: Hedda Gabler (1890): the play's deadliest actions carry no lines—Hedda leafing through Lövborg's manuscript, calling it 'unpardonable,' handing over the pistol for 'the most beautiful death'; the words are drawing-room courtesy, the acts are murder and desire; her one line about sleeping with her arm above her head speaks the whole pathology of her marriage. Ibsen's instruction to actors—'read beneath every line'—splits dialogue into two strata: the manifest (social) and the latent (real), dramatic tension living in the gap between them
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生潜台词工程法的核心命题是：社会性动物的真实意思永远不能直接明说——直接说出的真话会摧毁社交结构本身，因此意义必须被'工程化地转移'到别的载体上。常规表达把意义全放进明文（台词/文字/汇报），信息完整但张力为零；易卜生的替代方案分三步。第一步，双层书写：为每句台词写两层——明文层（该说的社交语言）与潜文层（真正想施加的意思），两层落差越大，张力越强。第二步，载体转移：把潜文安放在明文之外的载体上——停顿的长度、酒杯放下的位置、目光的落点、一封信被烧掉的时机；载体必须是可导演的（可排练、可重复、可被观众看见）。第三步，观众入伙：明文层要薄到观众能自己算出潜文层——观众'听懂弦外之音'的瞬间成为戏剧快感的核心；潜台词不写出来的部分正是观众参与创作的部分。深意有三重。其一，这是对'说出来的即真'的语言透明论的颠覆：在文明社会，语言的第一功能是遮蔽而非传递。其二，它把'不可言说'变成工程问题——不说破不等于不存在，可以移动、可以设计、可以在正确时机让第三者听见。其三，它直接发明了现代导演剧场与电影表演——契诃夫、斯特林堡、好莱坞'方法派'、现代影视的冰山对话全是这一工程的后代。适用边界：适合权力关系、情感博弈、体面社会；在信息必须精确传递的场合（技术规程、急救指令）明文优先，潜台词是灾难。现代对应物：谈判学'在场与桌面'（on the table vs under the table）、组织行为学的'房间里的大象'、品牌传播的'留白设计'、UI 文案里的'委婉损失框架'、公开信的'字里行间'读法。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's subtext-engineering method: a social animal's real meaning can never be said outright—truth spoken plainly would destroy the social structure itself, so meaning must be engineered onto other carriers. Conventional expression puts everything in the manifest text—complete information, zero tension. Ibsen's alternative has three steps. First, two-layer writing: give every line two layers—the manifest (social speech) and the latent (the meaning actually being applied); the wider the gap, the stronger the tension. Second, carrier transfer: lodge the latent meaning in carriers outside the words—length of pause, where the wine glass is set down, where the gaze lands, the timing of burning a letter; carriers must be directable—rehearsable, repeatable, visible to the audience. Third, enlisting the audience: keep the manifest layer thin enough that the audience computes the latent layer themselves; the pleasure of 'hearing what is not said' becomes the drama's core—the unwritten part of subtext is precisely the audience's share in authorship. Three layers of depth. First, it overthrows linguistic transparency—the belief that the said is the true: in civilized society language's first function is concealment, not conveyance. Second, it converts 'the unsayable' into an engineering problem—unspoken does not mean absent; it can be moved, designed, timed so a third party overhears. Third, it invented the modern director's theatre and screen acting—Chekhov, Strindberg, the Method, and every iceberg dialogue on film are descendants of this engineering. Boundaries: it suits power relations, emotional chess, polite society; where information must be exact—procedures, emergency instructions—plain text first; subtext there is a disaster. Modern counterparts: negotiation's on-the-table versus under-the-table, organizational 'elephants in the room,' brand design's white space, euphemistic loss-framing in UI copy, and reading a public letter between its lines.
modes.source_chapter: 《海达·高布乐》与《野鸭》（易卜生）；易卜生致演员的排演指示（转引自迈克尔·迈耶《易卜生传》）；萧伯纳《易卜生主义的精华》'对话的新技术'一章；埃里克·本特利《作为思想家戏剧家的易卜生》

载体转移到物件与停顿
两层落差即张力
观众参与计算潜文
语言的第一功能是遮蔽

modes.key_quote_zh: 读每一句话下面的意思——台词是给邻居听的，意思才是给对方听的。
modes.key_quote_en: Read beneath every line—the words are for the neighbors, the meaning is for the other person.
process_zh: 双层起草：为每段对话写两列——明文列（社交层该说的）与潜文列（真正要施加的）；无落差的台词删掉
选载体：把潜文从台词中卸下，安装到可导演的载体上——停顿、道具位移、视线、出入场时机
控制厚度：明文层保持社交上无懈可击、信息上故意残缺——残缺度等于观众必须自行计算的工作量
设触发点：在关键节点让潜文被'意外听见'或'物证显形'——潜台词的兑付要有戏剧性时刻
排练校准：观察观众/读者在哪一层笑、在哪一层沉默——落差过小则无戏，过大则失联
留缝收尾：最重要的潜文永远不兑付——留给观众回家路上的那一公里
process_en: Draft in two layers: write every dialogue in two columns—the manifest (socially proper) and the latent (actually applied); delete lines with no gap
Choose carriers: unload the latent meaning from speech into directable carriers—pauses, displaced props, gazes, entrances and exits
Control thickness: keep the manifest layer socially impeccable and informationally incomplete—the incompleteness equals the work the audience must compute
Set trigger points: at key nodes let subtext be overheard or surface as physical evidence—the cashing-in of subtext needs its dramatic moment
Calibrate in rehearsal: watch at which layer the audience laughs and at which it falls silent—too small a gap is no play, too wide is no connection
Leave the final seam open: the most important subtext is never cashed—reserved for the last mile of the audience's walk home
representative_cases_zh: 海达的酒杯与枪（1890）：《海达·高布乐》全部情欲与毁灭都装在酒杯的斟与不斟、枪的交与不交里——台词层是待客礼仪，潜文层是自杀教唆
娜拉与托伐的'甜话'（1879）：《玩偶之家》前两幕全是宠溺称呼与家庭甜语——正是这层明文让第三幕'咱们坐下谈谈'显得像判决书
瑞凌医生的药方（1884）：《野鸭》'生活谎言'理论全部经由医生对旧友的闲谈说出——潜文（我在替你维持谎言）藏在明文（开药方）之下
博克上司的'提携'（1877）：《社会支柱》博克每一句感谢与自谦都是讹诈的报价——斯多恩斯达特听得懂，观众跟着听懂
representative_cases_en: Hedda's glass and pistol (1890): all of Hedda Gabler's desire and destruction ride on whether the glass is filled and the pistol handed over—the manifest layer is hospitality, the latent layer is assisted suicide

Nora and Torvald's endearments (1879): the first two acts of A Doll's House are all pet names and domestic sweetness—precisely this manifest layer makes Act Three's 'let us sit down and talk' read like a verdict

Dr. Relling's prescription (1884): The Wild Duck's whole theory of the life-lie is spoken as a doctor's casual chat with an old friend—the latent (I am maintaining your lie for you) beneath the manifest (writing a prescription)
Bernick's patronage (1877): in Pillars of Society, Bernick's every word of thanks and self-deprecation is an extortionist's quotation; Lönestrand hears it, and the audience hears it with him
modern_applications_zh: 谈判与销售：把真实诉求移出口头明文、装进让步顺序与时间安排——'报价单上是价格，停顿里是底线'，训练团队读对方的潜文层
管理与反馈：绩效沟通的'三明治'本质是潜台词工程——明文是肯定与期待，潜文是'这个行为必须停'；写沟通稿先写两列
品牌与文案：高端品牌的广告几乎零产品参数——意义全在调性、镜头与留白里；'不说'成为最贵的说
写作与编剧训练：'冰山对话'练习——为每句台词写第二列'真正想说的'，然后只排演第二列、口头念第一列
modern_applications_en: Negotiation and sales: move real demands off the spoken record into concession order and timing—the quotation lists the price, the pause holds the floor; train teams to read the other side's latent layer
Management feedback: the feedback 'sandwich' is subtext engineering—manifest praise and expectation, latent 'this behavior must stop'; draft communications in two columns first
Brand and copywriting: luxury advertising carries near-zero product parameters—meaning lives in tone, shot, and white space; not-saying becomes the costliest saying
Writing and screenwriting training: the iceberg-dialogue drill—write a second column of 'what is really meant' for every line, then stage only column two while speaking column one

representative_figures.relation_zh: 潜台词的抒情化继承者——'人们吃饭，只说吃饭，而幸福正在破碎'，《三姐妹》的枪与《海达》的枪同一血脉
representative_figures.relation_en: the lyrical heir of subtext—'people eat dinner and merely speak of dinner while their happiness is breaking'; the gun of Three Sisters is of the same blood as Hedda's

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同代人兼对手——把潜台词推向更黑暗的心理战场，《朱莉小姐》的台词两层结构与易卜生互为镜像
representative_figures.relation_en: contemporary and rival—pushing subtext into a darker psychological battlefield; the two-strata dialogue of Miss Julie mirrors Ibsen's

representative_figures.relation_zh: 潜台词工程法的极致后人——停顿本身成为台词（'品特式停顿'），把易卜生的载体转移推到语言尽头
representative_figures.relation_en: the ultimate descendant—making the pause itself a line (the 'Pinter pause'), carrying Ibsen's carrier transfer to the far end of language

name_zh: 认知方法论/把谎言当作维系生命的器官而非道德污点来诊断——同时诊断两种病：谎言的腐蚀与'说出全部真相'的狂妄；拒绝在诚实与仁慈间站队
name_en: cognitive methodology/diagnosing the lie as a life-sustaining organ rather than a moral stain—diagnosing two diseases at once: the lie's corrosion and the arrogance of 'the whole truth'; refusing to side with either honesty or mercy
category: 认知方法论/把谎言当作维系生命的器官而非道德污点来诊断——同时诊断两种病：谎言的腐蚀与'说出全部真相'的狂妄；拒绝在诚实与仁慈间站队
modes.domain_zh: 1884《野鸭》：雅马太太靠一个家宅谎言（'这房子会属于艾克达尔家'）维持全家活着的意义； idealist 格瑞格斯强行向海特维格揭穿真相，女孩为证明爱而自杀——瑞凌医生结案陈词：'剥夺一个普通人的生活谎言，等于拿走他的幸福'。易卜生自己多年后补刀：'拿走生活谎言，幸福随之而去'——真理狂与谎言供养者同罪，这是欧洲文学第一次把'诚实'本身放上解剖台
modes.domain_en: The Wild Duck (1884): Mrs. Sorby's household lie keeps the whole family's meaning of life alive; the idealist Gregers forcibly exposes the truth to Hedvig, and the girl kills herself to prove her love—Dr. Relling's verdict: 'Rob the average man of his life-lie and you rob him of his happiness.' Ibsen himself later drove the knife in: 'Take away the life-lie from any human being and happiness goes with it.' The truth-fanatic and the lie-keeper are equally guilty—the first time in European literature that 'honesty' itself was put on the dissecting table
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生谎言病理法的核心命题是：'真/假'不是道德判据，'生存功能/腐蚀功能'才是——谎言与真相都是变量，其价值取决于对具体生命系统的净效应。常规立场把问题写成二选一：诚实是美德、欺骗是堕落；易卜生拒绝这个题目的前提，改问三步。第一步，功能定位：这个谎言在这个人的生命系统里承担什么功能？（意义维持、关系粘合、身份完整）——先把'症状器官'定位。第二步，双向病理：同时诊断两侧——谎言一侧的代价（信任结构空洞化、危机延迟放大）与揭谎一侧的代价（揭谎者常为享受道德快感而毁人，'真理狂'本身是一种权力欲）；格瑞格斯与雅马同病，只是病情不同。第三步，剂量决策：不问'该不该说'而问'多少、何时、由谁、以什么配菜说'——真相如药物，剂量与时机决定它是治疗还是毒杀。深意有三重。其一，这把道德问题转写为系统问题：一个人赖以站立的东西可能是错的，但拆掉支架之前必须先装新梁。其二，它比陀思妥耶夫斯基同题讨论更冷峻：没有救赎出口，只有权衡。其三，它预告了现代心理治疗的核心戒律——治疗师的诚实必须服务于来访者的承载力，而非自己的清白感。适用边界：适合亲密关系、组织文化、叙事疗愈等'人的系统'；对事实系统的科学问题是毒药——那里的谎言没有生存功能，只有误差。现代对应物：心理治疗的'治疗性不揭露'与时机敏感披露、临终关怀的信息告知伦理、组织变革的'真相剂量管理'、'善意的不问'礼仪、安慰剂研究的伦理学。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's life-lie pathology: 'true or false' is not the moral criterion—'life-sustaining or corroding' is; lie and truth are both variables whose value depends on net effect within a particular life-system. The conventional stance frames a binary: honesty a virtue, deceit a fall. Ibsen rejects the question's premise and asks instead, in three steps. First, locate the function: what does this lie do inside this person's life-system (meaning-maintenance, relational glue, identity integrity)—identify the symptom-organ first. Second, double-sided pathology: diagnose both sides at once—the lie's cost (hollowed trust, crises compounded by delay) and the exposure's cost (the exposer often destroys to enjoy moral pleasure; 'truth-fanaticism' is itself a will to power); Gregers and the household share one disease in different forms. Third, dosing decisions: not 'should it be said' but 'how much, when, by whom, served with what'—truth is a drug; dose and timing decide cure from killing. Three layers of depth. First, moral questions are rewritten as systems questions: what a person stands on may be wrong, but before removing the strut a new beam must be set. Second, it is colder than Dostoevsky's treatment of the same theme: no exit of redemption, only trade-offs. Third, it prefigures the core discipline of modern psychotherapy—a therapist's honesty must serve the client's bearing capacity, not the therapist's own sense of innocence. Boundaries: it suits human systems—intimate bonds, organizational culture, narrative healing; for factual-scientific questions it is poison—there lies have no life-function, only error. Modern counterparts: therapeutic non-disclosure and timing-sensitive disclosure, end-of-life information ethics, 'truth-dose management' in organizational change, the etiquette of merciful not-asking, and the ethics of placebo research.
modes.source_chapter: 《野鸭》第四、五幕瑞凌与格瑞格斯的对质（易卜生）；易卜生晚年关于'生活谎言'的自述（转引自迈克尔·迈耶《易卜生传》）；萧伯纳《易卜生主义的精华》论《野鸭》；卢·安德烈亚斯-莎乐美《易卜生的群像》
key_concepts: 谎言的生存功能定位
真理狂是另一种病
双向病理同时诊断
真相需要剂量与时机
拆支架前先装新梁
诚实服务于承载力而非清白感
modes.key_quote_zh: 拿走一个人的生活谎言，就等于拿走他的幸福——揭谎者与撒谎者，请在同一个诊室排队。
modes.key_quote_en: Take away the life-lie from any human being and you take away their happiness—exposer and liar, please queue in the same consulting room.
process_zh: 定位功能：先不评判真假，画清这个谎言在该生命系统中的功能——它供养着什么、维系着谁
双向开诊：同时列出谎言侧与揭谎侧的代价清单——特别警惕揭谎者的道德快感本身
评估承载力：问'这个人/这个组织现在承受得住多少真相'——承载力是剂量的唯一依据
设计剂量：把要说的事实切成可承载的份额，排时序、配支撑（新叙事先行、旧支架缓拆）
观察代谢：披露后观察系统的反应——意义是否重建、关系是否可续；不可续即为过量
保留核心谎言：承认有些谎言永远不该被拆——把它写进边界而不是装作它不存在
process_en: Locate the function: before judging truth, map what the lie sustains within the life-system—what it feeds, whom it holds
Open both files: list the costs on the lie side and the exposure side together—watching above all the exposer's own moral pleasure
Assess bearing capacity: ask how much truth this person or organization can bear now—capacity is the sole basis of dosage
Design the dose: split the facts into bearable shares, sequence them, provide supports (new narrative first, old strut removed slowly)
Watch the metabolism: after disclosure observe the system—whether meaning rebuilds and relations continue; if not, the dose was lethal
Keep the core lie: admit that some lies should never be dismantled—write them into the boundary rather than pretending they do not exist
representative_cases_zh: 《野鸭》双诊（1884）：格瑞格斯（真理狂，为'纯洁'毁掉女孩）与雅马家（谎言供养者）同诊室——易卜生不给观众一个可站队的好人
《建筑大师》的少女幻象（1892）：索尔尼斯靠'塔上挂花环'的表演性谎言维系创造欲——易卜生同时写出这谎言的滋养与致命
娜拉的'奇迹'（1879）：娜拉八年来靠'托伐会为我担当'的想象活着——揭穿该想象的那封信既是诚实也是谋杀
易卜生本人的家庭（1850s-）：他对私生子与妻儿的疏于照管，与他'普遍人性'宣言的对峙——作者未能治疗自己的病
representative_cases_en: The Wild Duck's double clinic (1884): Gregers (the truth-fanatic who ruins a girl for 'purity') and the Ekdal household (lie-sustainers) in one waiting room—Ibsen offers no good man to side with
The Master Builder's girlish vision (1892): Solness's performative lie of the wreath on the tower sustains his creative drive—Ibsen writes both its nourishment and its deadliness
Nora's 'wonder' (1879): for eight years Nora lives on the image that Torvald would take her place in sacrifice—the letter that shatters it is honesty and murder at once
Ibsen's own family (1850s on): his neglect of his illegitimate son, wife, and child versus his declaration of universal humanity—the author failed to treat his own disease
modern_applications_zh: 心理咨询实践：'治疗性不揭露'与披露时机——治疗师不追求自己的清白感，诚实以来访者的承载力为唯一剂量依据
临终告知伦理：病情告知的'剂量管理'——全 disclosure 对部分患者是治疗、对部分是毒杀；家属、医生、患者的三角谈判
组织变革沟通：裁员/转型期的'真相剂量'——一次全披露会击穿信任，零披露会击穿信誉；分批+新叙事先行的剂量设计
家庭关系：'善意的不问'与'拆穿青春期孩子的安全幻觉'——何时是保护、何时是剥夺，用承载力而非道德直觉判断
modern_applications_en: Psychotherapy practice: therapeutic non-disclosure and disclosure timing—the therapist seeks not their own innocence; capacity is the only basis of dosage
End-of-life disclosure ethics: dose-managed telling of prognosis—full disclosure cures some patients and kills others; the three-way negotiation of family, physician, patient
Organizational change communication: truth-dosing during layoffs and pivots—one-shot full disclosure breaks trust, zero disclosure breaks credibility; batched disclosure with the new narrative first
Family relations: merciful not-asking and puncturing an adolescent's safety illusions—protection versus deprivation, judged by capacity rather than moral instinct

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同题较量的对手——《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》的'宗教大法官'与《野鸭》同攻'人承受不起真相'，但陀氏给出救赎出口而易卜生只给权衡
representative_figures.relation_en: the rival on the same theme—the Grand Inquisitor and The Wild Duck both strike at 'man cannot bear the truth,' but Dostoevsky offers an exit of redemption where Ibsen offers only trade-offs

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同代人同命题——'真理是一种无休止的欺骗'与'没有艺术的生活谎言我们无法生活'，与瑞凌医生的处方互为印证
representative_figures.relation_en: contemporary on the same proposition—'truth as an endless deception' and 'without the life-lie of art we cannot live,' echoing Dr. Relling's prescription

representative_figures.relation_zh: 现代治疗师中的易卜生传人——把'治疗师的诚实服务于来访者承载力'写成存在主义心理治疗的临床戒律
representative_figures.relation_en: the modern therapist-heel of Ibsen—writing 'the therapist's honesty serves the client's bearing capacity' into existential psychotherapy's clinical discipline

name_zh: 公共判断方法论/把'多数人的意见'从默认正确改为默认待审——多数的声量与其正确率无关，且多数 常 由利益而非认知驱动；给说真话的少数以制度性保护
name_en: public-judgment methodology/putting 'majority opinion' from default-correct under default review—volume has no correlation with correctness, and majorities are driven by interest more than cognition; give the truth-telling minority institutional protection
category: 公共判断方法论/把'多数人的意见'从默认正确改为默认待审——多数的声量与其正确率无关，且多数 常 由利益而非认知驱动；给说真话的少数以制度性保护
modes.domain_zh: 1882《人民公敌》：斯多克芒医生发现浴场水源被污染，expected 全镇感谢——结果修浴场的钱全镇人都有份，'多数'投票表决他是'人民公敌'，游行喊打；他的答辩是全剧的方法论内核：'你们把我粉碎好了，可我告诉你们——世界上最坚强的人，就是那个最孤独地站着的人'。易卜生用一个医学事实（水里有菌）对抗全部社会事实（人人有份），逼观众看清：多数表决能决定利益分配，不能决定水里有没有菌
modes.domain_en: An Enemy of the People (1882): Dr. Stockmann finds the spa water contaminated and expects the town's gratitude—but since everyone has a stake in the spa's revenue, the 'majority' votes him 'an enemy of the people' and the crowd stones his windows; his answer carries the method's core: 'You should all be smashed, but I tell you—the strongest man in the world is he who stands most alone.' Ibsen pits one medical fact (bacteria in the water) against all social facts (everyone has a share), forcing the audience to see that a majority vote can allocate interests but cannot decide whether the water has bacteria
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生多数谬误法的核心命题是：表决权数的边界止于利益分配，不及于事实判断——'多数说 X 是好的'有约束力，'多数说 X 是真的'毫无效力。常规做法把多数当作认知背书（点赞、投票、从众），易卜生把多数改判为利益统计：三步操作。第一步，分离两类命题：把'好不好/要不要'（价值与利益命题，多数有权）与'是不是/有没有'（事实命题，多数无权）分开——浴场水里有菌，不因镇民投票而消失。第二步，解剖多数的成分：问'这个多数由谁构成、每个人的利害是什么'——当多数成员全部从同一立场获益，多数只是利益的合唱团；声量越大越要追问利益结构。第三步，给少数配制度：不是道德赞美孤独先知，而是给'说真话的少数'搭制度支架——数据公开权、异议免罚权、独立复核通道；先知姿态是错的起点，制度才是对的答案。深意有三重。其一，它与同时代的'从众心理学'与后世的阿希实验互证：多数的压力足以让眼睛说谎，群体规模与正确率无关。其二，它精确区分'民主'与'民粹'：民主是程序（含保护少数的程序），民粹是把多数票跨界用于事实。其三，它预言了现代科学治理的基石——同行评审不是投票，实验可重复不因引用量而改变。适用边界：适用于事实之争被利益裹挟的场合；但需警惕其镜像滥用——把'我是被围攻的少数'当作自己正确的证据（自封的先知同样要交出证据）。现代对应物：科学共同体对民调的拒斥、吹哨人保护制度、独立董事与独立监察、阿希/Asch 从众实验、'真理不靠举手'的法庭交叉询问制。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's majority-as-error method: the vote's writ ends at interest allocation and does not reach factual judgment—'the majority wants X' binds, 'the majority says X is true' binds nothing. The convention treats the majority as cognitive endorsement (likes, polls, conformity); Ibsen re-verdicts the majority as an interest statistic, in three steps. First, separate the two classes of proposition: 'good or not / shall we' (value and interest—where majorities have standing) from 'is or is not / does it exist' (fact—where they have none); the bacteria in the spa water do not vanish by town vote. Second, dissect the majority's composition: who makes it up and what each member stands to gain—when every member profits from the same position, the majority is an interest choir; the louder it is, the harder to ask about its interest structure. Third, give the minority scaffolding, not hymns: not moral praise of the lonely prophet but institutional support for the truth-telling few—right of data publication, immunity for dissent, channels of independent re-examination; the prophet posture is the wrong answer, institutions the right one. Three layers of depth. First, it cross-confirms conformity psychology from its own era to the Asch experiments: majority pressure can make eyes lie, and group size has no correlation with correctness. Second, it separates democracy from populism with precision: democracy is procedure (including protections for minorities), populism is carrying majority votes across the border into fact. Third, it foresees the foundation of modern scientific governance—peer review is not a vote, and replication does not bend to citation counts. Boundaries: it fits disputes of fact captured by interest; but guard against the mirror abuse—treating 'I am a besieged minority' as evidence of one's own correctness (the self-appointed prophet must also produce evidence). Modern counterparts: science's refusal of the referendum, whistleblower protection, independent directors and inspectors general, the Asch conformity experiments, and cross-examination in court—truth does not raise hands.
modes.source_chapter: 《人民公敌》第四、五幕（易卜生）；萧伯纳《易卜生主义的精华》'论民主与多数'一章；詹姆斯《实用主义》关于'真理与多数'的讨论（1907）；阿希《群体压力对判断的独立性与从众性》实验报告（1955，方法论的后世印证）
key_concepts: 表决权止于利益不及于事实
解剖多数的利害构成
声量与正确率无关
先知姿态是错答案制度是对答案
民主是程序民粹是跨界
被围攻不构成正确的证据
modes.key_quote_zh: 世界上最有力量的人，是那个最孤独地站着的人——但请先交出你水里有菌的证据。
modes.key_quote_en: The strongest man in the world is he who stands most alone—but first, hand over your evidence that the water has bacteria.
process_zh: 命题分诊：把争议拆成事实命题与价值命题两摞——事实摞收走表决权，价值摞保留多数权
利害透视：列出'多数'每部分成员的收益结构——从同一立场获益的多数按利益合唱团处理
证据优先：事实之争只认证据链与可重复性——引用量、点赞量、声量全部不进入事实判断
制度搭架：为说真话的少数预设保护（数据公开、异议免罚、独立复核）——在需要之前建好
警惕镜像：对'我是孤独先知'的自我叙事同样要求证据——被围攻与正确之间没有推理通道
程序收编：赢了事实之争后回到程序里推动改变——用民主程序兑现事实结论，而非用孤胆绕开程序
process_en: Triage the propositions: split the dispute into fact-stack and value-stack—withdraw the vote from the fact-stack, keep majority standing on the value-stack
X-ray the interests: map the gain structure of each part of the 'majority'—a majority all profiting from one position is treated as an interest choir
Evidence first: fact disputes admit only evidence chains and replicability—citations, likes, and volume never enter the factual judgment
Build the scaffold: pre-install protections for the truth-telling few (data publication, dissent immunity, independent re-examination)—before they are needed
Guard the mirror: demand evidence from 'I am a lonely prophet' narratives too—being besieged has no inferential road to being right
Return to procedure: after winning the fact fight, push change back through procedure—cash the factual verdict in democratic process rather than bypassing it as a lone hero
representative_cases_zh: 《人民公敌》浴场听证（1882）：医生带菌落报告 vs 全镇利益代表带表决——易卜生让'程序正确'把事实错杀，逼观众分诊命题
《社会支柱》的集体沉默（1877）：全城靠一个共同秘密维系'支柱'声誉——多数的体面恰是病灶的保护区
易卜生与挪威评论界（1880s）：《群鬼》被全欧剧评人围剿而他拒绝修改一个字——'被围攻'与'正确'在他身上同时成立，但他交出的是剧本
娜拉出走的选择（1879）：娜拉不听'所有人都会说你疯了'——把社会共识从决策变量中删去
representative_cases_en: The spa hearing (1882): the doctor's bacterial report against the town's interest representatives with a vote—Ibsen lets 'procedurally correct' wrongly kill the facts, forcing the audience to triage propositions
Pillars of Society's collective silence (1877): a whole town keeps its 'pillar' reputation on one shared secret—the majority's respectability is precisely the lesion's protected zone
Ibsen versus the critics (1880s): Ghosts was besieged by every European critic and he would not change a word—'besieged' and 'right' did both hold for him, but what he handed over was a script
Nora's choice to leave (1879): Nora disregards 'everyone will say you are mad'—deleting social consensus from her decision variables
modern_applications_zh: 科学传播与科普：气候变化/疫苗议题的'命题分诊'——'全球是否变暖'不投票，'减排成本怎么分摊'才投票；科普者先做这道分诊
公司治理：独立董事与吹哨人通道的设计逻辑——给'说真话的少数'搭制度支架，而非指望孤胆英雄
社交媒体素养：把点赞数从'可信度'维度删除——转发的多数是利益合唱团还是认知共同体，先查利害构成再查证据
产品决策：A/B 数据与'会议室多数意见'冲突时——数据是事实摞，会议室是利益摞，先分诊再讨论
modern_applications_en: Science communication: proposition triage on climate and vaccines—'is it warming' takes no vote, 'who pays for mitigation' does; the communicator triages first
Corporate governance: the design logic of independent directors and whistleblower channels—scaffolding for the truth-telling few rather than hopes for a lone hero
Social-media literacy: delete like-counts from the credibility dimension—ask first whether the forwarding majority is an interest choir or a cognitive community, then examine the evidence
Product decisions: when A/B data and the meeting-room majority conflict—data is the fact-stack, the meeting the interest-stack; triage before discussing

representative_figures.relation_zh: '多数即谬误'的雅典原型——五百人陪审团表决死刑，'未经省察的人生不值得过'是《人民公敌》的两千年前版本
representative_figures.relation_en: the Athenian prototype of majority-as-error—a jury of five hundred votes death; 'the unexamined life is not worth living' is An Enemy of the People, two thousand years early

representative_figures.relation_zh: 《论自由》第二章的'异端可能在任何时候都是真理'——为易卜生的多数批判提供了自由主义的理论装甲
representative_figures.relation_en: On Liberty chapter two, 'the heretic may at any time be right'—the liberal theoretical armor for Ibsen's critique of the majority

representative_figures.relation_zh: 从众实验的实证者——三分之一的判断随多数改错、线段长短都敢看错，为《人民公敌》补上了七十年后的实验证据
representative_figures.relation_en: the experimentalist of conformity—a third of judgments bending to the majority, eyes misreading even line lengths—supplying An Enemy of the People its experimental evidence seventy years later

name_zh: 表达方法论/把抽象主题压缩进一件可触摸的具体物件——野鸭、高塔、信箱、窗帘；让观众绕过说教直接用手摸到主题
name_en: expression methodology/compressing an abstract theme into one touchable concrete object—the wild duck, the tower, the letterbox, the curtains; letting the audience touch the theme past all sermon
category: 表达方法论/把抽象主题压缩进一件可触摸的具体物件——野鸭、高塔、信箱、窗帘；让观众绕过说教直接用手摸到主题
modes.domain_zh: 1884《野鸭》：一只中弹潜底、宁可憋死也不浮出水面的野鸭，被装进阁楼的旧木箱——它同时是：受伤而躲进幻想的全家、海特维格的替代性爱与希望、'生活谎言'的实物标本；观众说不清野鸭'代表'什么，但每个人都摸得到它。易卜生的道具从不解释自己：《玩偶之家》的信箱（钥匙在丈夫手里）把婚姻权力结构装进一只铁盒，《建筑大师》的高塔把艺术家的虚荣与恐惧装进一部楼梯
modes.domain_en: The Wild Duck (1884): a wild duck shot in flight that dives and would rather drown than surface, kept in an attic garret—simultaneously the whole family wounded and hiding in fantasy, Hedvig's displaced love and hope, and the physical specimen of the 'life-lie'; no one can say what the duck 'stands for,' yet everyone can touch it. Ibsen's props never explain themselves: the letterbox of A Doll's House (key in the husband's pocket) packs the marriage's power structure into one iron box; the tower of The Master Builder packs the artist's vanity and fear into one staircase
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生象征道具法的核心命题是：抽象主题只有压缩进一件具体物件，才能绕过观众的说教防御、直接进入体感记忆。常规表达用论说承载主题（台词直接说'自由''谎言''虚荣'），观众以理性接收、以理性遗忘；易卜生的替代路线分三步。第一步，选宿主：为抽象主题找一件'在剧情内本来就有用'的具体物件（信要投递、枪要挂墙、鸭要喂养）——象征功能寄生在叙事功能上，不露痕迹。第二步，多义装载：物件必须同时可作两种以上读法（野鸭=受伤者=替代物=标本），多义性让不同观众各自认领——象征一旦只有一种官方解释，就退化成标语。第三步，物理操作：主题的重大转折全部通过'对物件的物理操作'完成（烧信、递枪、开信箱、爬塔）——动作比台词更接近身体记忆，观众离场时台词会忘，'那声关门'忘不掉。深意有三重。其一，这是记忆的工程学：具象物件的记忆留存率远高于命题——人类文明靠'物证'而非'论点'传承。其二，它把解释权交给观众——道具不说破，是尊重观众智力的最小形式。其三，它发明了现代舞台美术与电影道具系统——《公民凯恩》的'玫瑰花蕾'、契诃夫的樱桃园、当代影视的一切'关键道具'皆出于此。适用边界：适合长期留存、跨语境传播的作品；对纯时效信息（新闻快讯、操作指引）具象化反而是噪声。现代对应物：品牌符号学（logo 作为宿主物件）、'玫瑰花蕾'式电影麦格芬、产品设计的'关键交互物'（按钮/开关的仪式感）、记忆宫殿法的具象锚点。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's symbolic-prop method: an abstract theme, to slip past the audience's sermon-defenses and enter bodily memory, must be compressed into one concrete object. Conventional expression carries theme by argument (lines that say 'freedom,' 'lies,' 'vanity' outright)—received by reason, forgotten by reason. Ibsen's route has three steps. First, choose the host: find a concrete object that is already useful inside the plot (letters must be mailed, a pistol hung on the wall, a duck fed)—the symbolic function parasitizes the narrative function without showing. Second, load it with multiplicity: the object must sustain two or more readings at once (the duck = the wounded = the surrogate = the specimen); multiplicity lets different audiences each claim their own—once a symbol has only one official interpretation it degrades into a slogan. Third, act physically: the theme's great turns happen through physical operations on the object (burning the letter, handing over the pistol, opening the letterbox, climbing the tower)—action reaches bodily memory closer than speech; lines will be forgotten on the way out, 'that door slam' never. Three layers of depth. First, this is the engineering of memory: concrete objects retain far better than propositions—civilizations transmit by evidence, not by theses. Second, it hands interpretation to the audience—an unexplained prop is the minimal form of respect for the audience's intelligence. Third, it invented modern stage design and the film prop system—'Rosebud,' Chekhov's orchard, every 'key prop' in contemporary film descend from it. Boundaries: it suits work meant to persist across contexts; for pure timeliness—news flashes, how-to instructions—concretizing is noise. Modern counterparts: brand semiotics (the logo as host object), the Rosebud-type MacGuffin, 'key interaction objects' in product design (the ritual of a button or switch), and the concrete anchors of the method of loci.
modes.source_chapter: 《野鸭》剧本与易卜生舞台指示（1884，道具说明尤为详尽）；《玩偶之家》与《建筑大师》舞台指示；萧伯纳《易卜生主义的精华》论'技术'；马丁·艾斯林《戏剧剖析》论舞台象征
key_concepts: 象征寄生在叙事功能上
一物必须两读
主题转折经由物理操作
动作比台词接近身体记忆
不解释是最小的尊重
物证比论点传承文明
modes.key_quote_zh: 别让观众听懂主题——让他们摸到那只野鸭，主题自己会回家。
modes.key_quote_en: Do not let the audience understand the theme—let them touch the wild duck, and the theme will find its way home.
process_zh: 选宿主：在剧情内找一件本来就有用的具体物件——象征功能寄生其上，观众不设防
装载多义：为物件写至少两种互不取消的读法——每种读法各给一条剧情证据线
安排操作：把主题的关键转折写成对物件的动作（烧/递/开/爬）——动作不写进台词而是写进舞台指示
克制解释：全剧不出现任何一句对该物件象征意义的解说——说破即降级为标语
回收呼应：让物件在开场/中点/结尾以不同状态出现三次（信箱：空/满/烧）——状态差即主题弧
留下余温：结尾让物件保持在场而不闭合——观众离场时它还在桌上
process_en: Choose the host: find a concrete object already useful within the plot—parasitize the symbol on it and the audience lowers no guard
Load the multiplicity: write at least two readings that do not cancel, each with its own thread of plot evidence
Stage the operations: write the theme's key turns as actions on the object (burn, hand over, open, climb)—into stage directions, not lines
Withhold explanation: not one line in the play decodes the object's symbolism—spoken, it degrades into a slogan
Ring the changes: let the object appear in three states (letterbox empty, full, burned)—the state difference is the theme's arc
Leave it warm: end with the object still present and unclosed—when the audience leaves, it is still on the table
representative_cases_zh: 野鸭的木箱（1884）：中弹潜底的鸟=全家=海特维格=生活谎言，四重装载无一说破——现代戏剧第一个'关键道具'
《玩偶之家》的信箱（1879）：钥匙在丈夫手里，妻子的信件由丈夫分发——婚姻的权力结构不用一句台词就装进铁盒
《建筑大师》的高塔（1892）：恐惧与虚荣的垂直化——全剧的楼梯是被烧伤记忆的立体地图
《海达》的手枪（1890）：'最美丽的死法'的供词由一把祖传枪完成——凶器即遗物即情书
representative_cases_en: The duck's garret box (1884): a shot duck that dives = the family = Hedvig = the life-lie, fourfold and never explained—the first 'key prop' of modern drama
A Doll's House's letterbox (1879): key in the husband's pocket, the wife's mail distributed by him—the marriage's power structure packed into an iron box without a line of dialogue
The Master Builder's tower (1892): fear and vanity made vertical—the whole staircase is a three-dimensional map of the burned memory
Hedda's pistols (1890): 'the most beautiful death' confessed through an heirloom gun—weapon, relic, and love letter in one
modern_applications_zh: 品牌与产品：把品牌价值压缩进一个'剧情内本来就有用'的物件/交互——苹果的开箱、无印良品的包装、特斯拉的开门仪式；价值寄生在功能上
影视与短视频创作：为每个作品找一件'关键道具'并安排三次状态变化——低成本高记忆的叙事杠杆
教学与培训设计：把抽象原理装进一个可触摸教具（经济学的邮票、物理学的摆锤）——体感锚点比 PPT 命题留存率高一个量级
个人叙事与纪念：家庭传承不靠训话靠'物证'——一块手表、一本账本，状态变化的物件自己会讲三代人
modern_applications_en: Brand and product: compress brand value into an object or interaction already useful in the 'plot'—Apple's unboxing, MUJI's packaging, Tesla's door ceremony; value parasitizing function
Film and short-video craft: find each work one key prop and stage three state changes—a narrative lever of low cost and high retention

Teaching and training design: load abstract principles into a touchable prop (the postage stamp for economics, the pendulum for physics)—a bodily anchor outretains the slide's proposition by an order of magnitude
Personal narrative and legacy: families transmit by evidence, not lectures—one watch, one ledger; an object with changing states tells three generations by itself

representative_figures.relation_zh: 道具象征的抒情化继承者——樱桃园的斧声与《野鸭》的木箱同宗：'墙上挂着的枪必须在第三幕响'的写出者
representative_figures.relation_en: the lyrical heir of the symbolic prop—the axe in The Cherry Orchard and the duck's box are of one line; the author of 'a gun on the wall in act one must fire in act three'

representative_figures.relation_zh: '玫瑰花蕾'的发明者——把易卜生的道具象征移植进电影，雪橇成为电影史上最有名的木箱
representative_figures.relation_en: inventor of 'Rosebud'—transplanting Ibsen's prop symbolism into film; the sled became cinema's most famous wooden box

representative_figures.relation_zh: 把'物件承载抽象'推到当代艺术——油脂与毛毡承载创伤记忆，物证美学在装置艺术中的直系后裔
representative_figures.relation_en: carrying 'the object bearing the abstract' into contemporary art—fat and felt carrying traumatic memory; the direct descendant of the evidence-aesthetic in installation

name_zh: 社会分析方法/把整个文明的政治病灶压缩进一间客厅、一昼夜、三五个人——微观切片显影宏观结构；最小的房间是最大的镜面
name_en: social-analysis methodology/compressing a civilization's political pathology into one parlor, one day, three or five people—the micro-section develops the macro-structure; the smallest room is the largest mirror
category: 社会分析方法/把整个文明的政治病灶压缩进一间客厅、一昼夜、三五个人——微观切片显影宏观结构；最小的房间是最大的镜面
modes.domain_zh: 1877-1882 五部问题剧：银行贿选（全是董事会客厅里的一句话）、妇女地位（全是婚床与壁炉之间）、遗传病（全是餐桌上的一杯酒）——易卜生把议会、教会、婚姻制度全部折叠进市民客厅的'三一律'；他说'我写的是全人类'，而他从未写过一个广场——全人类都是在客厅里被代表的
modes.domain_en: The five problem plays of 1877-82: electoral bribery of a bank (all of it one line in a boardroom parlor), women's status (all of it between the marriage bed and the hearth), hereditary disease (all of it one glass at the dinner table)—Ibsen folded parliament, church, and marriage law into the classical unities of the bourgeois parlor; 'I am writing about all humanity,' he said, and he never wrote a single public square—all humanity is represented in drawing rooms
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生客厅切片法的核心命题是：宏大系统的全部要素都浓缩在其最小的日常单元里——政治在餐桌的座位安排里，经济在一句'这钱不能说出去'里，制度在谁拿着信箱钥匙里。常规分析直接处理宏观（统计、政策、史诗叙事），数据完整但不可感；易卜生的替代路线分三步。第一步，选切片：找到该系统'日常运转的最小自足单元'（一个家庭、一间办公室、一个班级）——单元内必须完整存在目标系统的权力结构与利益循环。第二步，设压缩比：把宏观要素按'人物=机构、对话=政治、道具=法律'的映射关系压进单元——每个角色都是一种社会力量的化身，每件家具都是一项制度的遗址。第三步，让切片自己显影：不解说映射关系，只让单元内的日常事件照常发生——观众看着一桩'借据风波'，看见了整个信用社会。深意有三重。其一，这是'整体论'的戏剧化：全息原理——每个局部都编码着整体的信息，分析者要有本事选对切片。其二，它把'不可见结构'变成可观察行为：制度看不见，但'谁可以碰信箱'看得见。其三，它发明了现代心理—社会现实主义：从契诃夫的庄园、奥尼尔的船舱到当代职场剧的格子间，全是这一方法的切片谱系。适用边界：适合权力结构、家庭、组织等'单元内自足'的系统；对本质上跨尺度、无最小单元的现象（气候、流行病动力学）切片会失真。现代对应物：人类学的'深描'（Geertz）、田野个案研究、'一屋看一国'的非虚构（如《我在底层的生活》）、组织诊断的一线访谈法、纪录片'微观叙事'手法。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's drawing-room-section method: every element of a vast system is concentrated in its smallest daily unit—politics in the seating at a dinner table, economics in one sentence of 'this must not get out,' institutions in whoever holds the letterbox key. Conventional analysis works macro directly—statistics, policy, epic narrative: complete data, no feeling. Ibsen's route has three steps. First, choose the section: find the system's smallest self-sufficient daily unit (a family, an office, a classroom)—the unit must contain the target system's full power structure and interest circulation. Second, set the compression ratio: map macro elements into the unit—characters as institutions, dialogue as politics, props as law; every character an incarnation of a social force, every piece of furniture a ruin of an institution. Third, let the section develop itself: explain none of the mapping; let the unit's ordinary events proceed—watching a 'dispute over a promissory note,' the audience sees an entire credit society. Three layers of depth. First, it dramatizes holism: the holographic principle—every part encodes the whole, and the analyst's skill lies in choosing the right section. Second, it converts invisible structures into observable behavior: institutions cannot be seen, but 'who may touch the letterbox' can. Third, it invented modern psycho-social realism—Chekhov's estates, O'Neill's cabins, and the cubicles of every contemporary workplace drama are all section-lineages. Boundaries: it suits systems self-sufficient within a unit—power structures, families, organizations; for phenomena inherently cross-scale with no smallest unit (climate, epidemic dynamics) the section distorts. Modern counterparts: Geertz's thick description, field case studies, one-room-one-nation nonfiction (Nickel and Dimed), frontline interviewing in organizational diagnosis, and micro-narrative in documentary.
modes.source_chapter: 《社会支柱》《玩偶之家》《群鬼》《人民公敌》舞台指示与场景设置（1877-1882）；萧伯纳《易卜生主义的精华》'客厅即社会'章；乔治·卢卡奇《小说理论》关于'微观世界'的讨论；迈克尔·迈耶《易卜生传》创作年表
key_concepts: 最小自足单元即全息切片
人物=机构道具=法律的映射
不可见结构的可观察化
切片自己显影不解说
客厅比广场更政治
全人类在客厅里被代表
modes.key_quote_zh: 不必写整个王国——写好一张餐桌的座位，王国的等级表就在上面了。
modes.key_quote_en: No need to write the whole kingdom—set the seats at one dinner table well, and the kingdom's hierarchy is printed on it.
process_zh: 选切片：识别目标系统的最小自足日常单元——单元内必须完整存在权力结构与利益循环，缺一即换切片
定映射：写明压缩比——宏观的每个要素（制度/阶层/舆论）各由单元内的什么（人物/道具/话题）承载
保日常：切片内只发生'本来就会发生'的事件（过节、会客、算账）——事件越小，显影的结构越大
藏机关：把权力机关藏在物件与习惯里（钥匙、座位、称呼、账本）——不写进台词写进舞台指示
限时空：用一昼夜、一场景的'三一律'压缩——时间越紧，结构越紧；空间越小，回声越大
借外力：安排一个外来者/归来者进切片——他的错愕替观众读出这里'平常得可怕'的东西
process_en: Choose the section: identify the target system's smallest self-sufficient daily unit—it must contain the full power structure and interest loop; if any is missing, change sections
Set the mapping: state the compression ratio—what in the unit (person, prop, topic) carries each macro element (institution, class, opinion)
Keep it ordinary: let only events that 'would happen anyway' occur (holidays, visits, accounting)—the smaller the event, the larger the structure it develops
Hide the machinery: lodge power's mechanism in objects and habits (keys, seats, forms of address, ledgers)—into stage directions, not lines
Compress time and space: a single day, a single room, the classical unities—the tighter the time, the tighter the structure; the smaller the room, the larger the echo
Bring in an outsider: send a returnee or newcomer into the section—his bewilderment reads aloud for the audience what is 'terrifyingly normal' here
representative_cases_zh: 《玩偶之家》的圣诞（1879）：一桩家庭债务案=妇女财产权+婚姻法+银行信用体系的全息切片——挪威议会辩论十年的议题在一张圣诞树下完成
《社会支柱》的船期（1877）：一艘要不要准点开的船=整个'体面社会'的成本核算——伯尼克家客厅里完成对全镇经济的审判
《海达》的两间客厅（1890）：泰斯曼的书房与勃拉克将军的办公厅——书桌与手枪的位置关系就是学术自由与官僚权力的位置关系
《建筑大师》的楼梯（1892）：一部室内楼梯=艺术生涯的全部社会学——谁配上塔、谁扶谁、谁看着谁摔
representative_cases_en: A Doll's House's Christmas (1879): one household debt case as a holographic section of women's property rights, marriage law, and the credit system—a decade of parliamentary debate completed under one Christmas tree
Pillars of Society's sailing schedule (1877): whether a ship sails on time is the whole 'respectable society's' cost accounting—trial of the town's economy conducted in Bernick's parlor
Hedda's two rooms (1890): Tesman's study and General Gabler's ballroom—the spatial relation of desk and pistol is the spatial relation of academic freedom and bureaucratic power
The Master Builder's staircase (1892): one interior staircase as the entire sociology of an artistic career—who may climb, who steadies whom, who watches whom fall
modern_applications_zh: 组织诊断：进一家公司不先看年报先看一个部门的一周例会——座位、打断、谁倒水，组织真正的权力图在例会里，不在 org chart 里
田野调查与非虚构：'一屋看一国'写作法——选一个最小自足单元（一家小店、一个微信群）完整住进去，宏观议题全部通过单元内日常显影
产品设计调研：家庭入户观察——用户研究员在厨房与客厅的角落看到的，比问卷上的'满意度'多出一个制度层
内容创作：把宏大议题装进'一个房间几个人一昼夜'的短剧本——小切口是唯一能让算法观众看完宏观议题的形式
modern_applications_en: Organizational diagnosis: enter a company not via the annual report but via one department's weekly meeting—seating, interruptions, who pours the water; the real power map lives in the meeting, not the org chart
Fieldwork and nonfiction: the one-room-one-nation method—move into the smallest self-sufficient unit (one shop, one group chat) and let macro issues develop through its ordinary days
Product research: in-home observation—what a researcher sees in the corners of kitchen and parlor exceeds the questionnaire's 'satisfaction' by an entire institutional layer
Content creation: fitting grand topics into a 'one room, few people, one day' mini-script—the small incision is the only form in which algorithmic audiences will finish a macro subject

representative_figures.relation_zh: 客厅切片的抒情化继承者——一座庄园=俄国改革十年的切片，《樱桃园》的斧声与易卜生的信箱同一压缩比
representative_figures.relation_en: the lyrical heir of the section—one estate as a cross-section of a decade of Russian reform; the axe in The Cherry Orchard shares Ibsen's compression ratio

representative_figures.relation_zh: 把切片搬进美国家庭——《长日入夜行》的一间客厅一昼夜=美国天主教家庭与成瘾的总体解剖
representative_figures.relation_en: carried the section into the American home—Long Day's Journey into Night: one parlor, one day, the total anatomy of the American Catholic family and addiction

representative_figures.relation_zh: 人类学中的同构者——'深描'斗鸡=巴厘社会总切片，与易卜生共享'最小单元显影整体'的方法论宣言
representative_figures.relation_en: the isomorphic figure in anthropology—thick description of a cockfight as Bali's total section, sharing Ibsen's methodological manifesto of the smallest unit developing the whole

name_zh: 决策与叙事方法论/把'不解决'本身写成结论——用一声关门代替和解或死亡，把问题的解决外包给观众与时代；结尾是论证的完成而非情节的安顿
name_en: decision-and-narrative methodology/writing 'non-resolution' itself as the conclusion—a door slam instead of reconciliation or death, outsourcing the problem's solution to the audience and the era; the ending as the completion of an argument, not the settling of a plot
category: 决策与叙事方法论/把'不解决'本身写成结论——用一声关门代替和解或死亡，把问题的解决外包给观众与时代；结尾是论证的完成而非情节的安顿
modes.domain_zh: 1879《玩偶之家》最后一分钟：娜拉放下婚戒，说'咱们俩必须把这件事谈清楚'，门外一声关门——没有和解、没有死亡、没有答案；柏林首演后报纸哀叹'这扇门让半个欧洲的丈夫彻夜难眠'。易卜生本来被要求写'另一个结局'（娜拉看孩子一眼留下），他写了、然后自己称其为'野蛮的 surgery'——他清楚：让娜拉留下，论证就死了
modes.domain_en: The last minute of A Doll's House (1879): Nora sets down the rings, says 'we two must sit down and settle this,' and a door slams outside—no reconciliation, no death, no answer; after the Berlin premiere the papers lamented that 'this door kept half of Europe's husbands awake.' Asked for an alternative ending (Nora glances at her children and stays), he wrote it and then called it 'a barbaric outrage'—he knew that if Nora stayed, the argument died
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生出走结尾法的核心命题是：当一个问题的正确状态是'保持开放'时，任何闭合（和解/胜利/悲剧收场）都是论证的失败——结尾的最高形态是把问题作为遗产移交给观众。常规叙事以闭合为目标（大团圆或大悲剧），观众带着'解决了'的幻觉离场；易卜生的替代路线分三步。第一步，确认问题不可在当下解决：先诚实诊断——妇女地位、制度积弊这类问题没有单人结局，任何'当场解决'都是作弊。第二步，让行动完成论证而非完成情节：主人公的最后一个动作必须精确回答'作品的问题'（娜拉的'首先我是个人'）——动作是命题的落款，不是情绪的宣泄。第三步，把余响外包：不写出走之后——娜拉去哪里、靠什么生活，正是留给每个观众和每个时代的作业；开放结尾不是逃避责任而是责任的转移方式。深意有三重。其一，它区分了'安慰'与'真理'：闭合给安慰，开放给真理，易卜生选后者并承受'不讨喜'的代价。其二，它发明了'参与式作品'：未完成的部分由观众以其人生补完——一部剧因此在每个时代重演时都重写一次。其三，它对决策实践同样有效：有时'暂不决定、保持问题在场'本身就是最优决策——把伪闭合当作决策失误的风险，不小于把开放当逃避。适用边界：适合结构性问题、时代命题、需要长期动员的议题；对必须当机立断的操作问题（急救、危机处置）开放等于失职。现代对应物：纪录片与文学的'无结论报道'、产品决策的'明确搁置清单'、therapy 的'带着问题生活'、开放式结局电影（特吕弗、洪常秀）、法律上的'留待判例发展'条款。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's departure-ending method: when the correct state of a question is 'kept open,' any closure—reconciliation, victory, tragic wrap-up—is a failure of the argument; the highest form of an ending is to hand the question on to the audience as an inheritance. Conventional narrative aims at closure (happy or tragic), sending the audience off with the illusion 'solved.' Ibsen's route has three steps. First, confirm the question cannot be solved now: diagnose honestly—questions like women's status have no single-person ending, and any on-the-spot solution is cheating. Second, let the action complete the argument, not the plot: the protagonist's final move must answer precisely the work's question (Nora's 'first and foremost I am a human being')—the action is the proposition's signature, not an outpouring of emotion. Third, outsource the resonance: write nothing of what comes after—where Nora goes and how she will live is homework for every audience member and every era; the open ending is not an evasion of responsibility but a way of transferring it. Three layers of depth. First, it separates comfort from truth: closure gives comfort, openness gives truth; Ibsen chose truth and paid for its unpopularity. Second, it invented the participatory work: the unfinished part is completed by each audience member's life—the play is rewritten every time it is revived in a new era. Third, it works for decision practice too: sometimes 'not deciding yet, keeping the question alive' is the optimal decision—the risk of false closure is no smaller than the risk of open-ended evasion. Boundaries: it suits structural questions, the propositions of an era, issues needing long mobilization; for matters demanding immediate decision (emergency, crisis handling) openness is dereliction. Modern counterparts: the no-conclusion report in documentary and letters, the explicit parked-decisions list in product work, therapy's 'living with the question,' the open-ended film (Truffaut, Hong Sang-soo), and legal clauses left to developing case law.
modes.source_chapter: 《玩偶之家》第三幕与'德语版另一结局'往来函件（1879-1880）；易卜生致路德维希·帕斯奇的信（转引自迈克尔·迈耶《易卜生传》）；萧伯纳《易卜生主义的精华》'论结局'；埃里克·本特利《作为思想家戏剧家的易卜生》论开放结尾
key_concepts: 问题不可当场解决是前提
动作是命题的落款
余响外包给观众与时代
闭合给安慰开放给真理
参与式作品的未完成性
保持问题在场也是决策
modes.key_quote_zh: 让门在最后一秒响——戏在门后继续，而作业在观众手里。
modes.key_quote_en: Let the door slam in the final second—the play goes on behind it, and the homework is in the audience's hands.
process_zh: 诊断可解性：先诚实回答'这个问题有没有单人单日解'——没有则预告自己不做伪闭合
落款动作：设计一个精确回答作品核心命题的最终动作（出走/放下/点烟）——动作先于台词、替代台词
删安插：检查结尾是否有任何'善后安排'（新工作、新恋情、和解拥抱）——每删一处，问题就多留一分
保护歧义：确认观众至少能带走两种结论（'她勇敢'与'她任性'）——单一读法即标语，双读法即作品
承受骂名：预期'没讲完'的批评并公开应答——解释'开放是设计不是偷懒'，然后不改
移交作业：在语境允许时留下'下一步在哪里'的线索（娜拉的手袋、未寄的信）——作业要有起笔处
process_en: Diagnose solvability: answer honestly whether the question has a single-person, single-day solution; if not, declare in advance that no false closure is coming
The signature action: design a final move that answers the work's core proposition exactly (departure, laying down, lighting up)—action precedes and replaces speech
Delete the arrangements: check the ending for any 'aftercare' (new job, new love, a reconciling embrace)—each deletion leaves the question one degree more open
Protect the ambiguity: confirm the audience can leave holding at least two verdicts ('she is brave' and 'she is willful')—one reading is a slogan, two readings a work
Bear the abuse: expect the 'unfinished' criticism and answer it publicly—explain that openness is design, not laziness, then change nothing
Hand over the homework: where context allows, leave a thread of 'where next' (Nora's bag, the unsent letter)—homework needs a place to begin
representative_cases_zh: 《玩偶之家》的门（1879）：一声关门=现代个人主义的宣言+未完成的社会工程——德国剧院强加的'温和结局'被易卜生自己骂作'野蛮的 surgery'
《海达·高布乐》的自尽（1890）：海达的死不是闭合而是最后的未答——她 '不为美死'的失败恰恰把问题留给观众
《当我们死人醒来时》的雪崩（1899）：晚年自反的终章以自然死亡收束，艺术家的自审没有任何救赎——留给观众
娜拉的'奇迹'承诺（1879）：'除非我们俩都变成能真正对话的人，奇迹才发生'——把婚姻的解法外包给没有时限的未来
representative_cases_en: The Doll's House door (1879): one slam as manifesto of modern individualism and unfinished social engineering—the German theatres' imposed gentler ending Ibsen himself damned as 'a barbaric outrage'
Hedda's suicide (1890): her death closes nothing and answers nothing—her failure to die 'for beauty' is precisely what leaves the question with the audience
The avalanche of When We Dead Awaken (1899): the final chapter of self-reckoning ends in natural death, the artist's self-judgment offered no redemption—left to the audience
Nora's 'wonder' (1879): 'unless the two of us become people who can truly talk, the wonder will not happen'—outsourcing marriage's solution to a future without deadline
modern_applications_zh: 产品与战略决策：为'结构性问题'建立'明确搁置清单'并公开——写明'本季度不解决'比假装解决更能保住团队信任
纪实与深度报道：'无结论报道'的伦理——当事态需要社会长期行动时，记者的克制结尾是把行动权交给读者
心理咨询收尾：治疗结束不宣告'痊愈'而写'带着这个问题的新的相处方式'——把开放写进病程记录
教学设计：结课不留'标准答案'而留'下一步去哪里查/做什么'——作业的起笔处即课程的门响
modern_applications_en: Product and strategy decisions: an explicit parked-decisions list for structural questions, published—declaring 'not this quarter' preserves trust better than pretending a solution
Documentary and deep reporting: the ethics of the no-conclusion report—when events demand long social action, the restrained ending hands agency to the reader
Closing therapy: ending treatment by writing 'a new way of living with this question,' never 'cured'—openness entered into the clinical record
Course design: finish a class with no standard answer but with 'where to look, what to do next'—the homework's first stroke is the course's door slam

representative_figures.relation_zh: 《娜拉走后怎样》(1923) 的提出者——他接过易卜生留下的'作业'：不是堕落就是回来——出走结尾法最深刻的后世应答
representative_figures.relation_en: poser of 'What Happens After Nora Leaves?' (1923)—he took up Ibsen's homework: she degenerates or she returns—the deepest later response to the departure-ending

representative_figures.relation_zh: 《四百击》的定格与跑——把'出走结尾'移植进电影，少年跑向海边的那一帧是娜拉的门在银幕上的变奏
representative_figures.relation_en: The 400 Blows' freeze-frame and run—transplanted the departure-ending into cinema; the boy running to the sea is Nora's door, varied for the screen

representative_figures.relation_zh: 易卜生主义的系统阐释者——把'问题剧不闭合'写进《易卜生主义的精华》，再以自己的《卖花女》结尾'留白式收场'实践之
representative_figures.relation_en: systematizer of Ibsenism—wrote the problem play's non-closure into The Quintessence of Ibsenism and practiced it in Pygmalion's open close

name_zh: 价值批判方法论/把被普遍供奉的理想词（自由、真理、爱情、艺术）拿上解剖台，验明它在具体生活里实际产出什么——词的崇高与产出的惨淡之间的落差即作品
name_en: value-critique methodology/putting universally worshipped ideal-words (freedom, truth, love, art) on the dissecting table to verify what they actually produce in concrete living—the gap between the word's sublimity and its output is the work
category: 价值批判方法论/把被普遍供奉的理想词（自由、真理、爱情、艺术）拿上解剖台，验明它在具体生活里实际产出什么——词的崇高与产出的惨淡之间的落差即作品
modes.domain_zh: 1866《布朗德》与 1867《培尔·金特》背靠背解剖两个极端：布朗德是'全有或全无'的理想主义者，用'意志'的绝对律令压死母亲、妻子与儿子——理想的纯度即是残酷的纯度；培尔·金特则是彻底不坚持任何理想的'自我主义者'，用'绕开'活了一生，最后只能在洋葱的层层剥落里找自己而找不到'核心'——两部剧合起来：理想主义与机会主义是同一种病（不与人真实相处的两种方式）
modes.domain_en: Brand (1866) and Peer Gynt (1867) dissect two extremes back to back: Brand, the 'all-or-nothing' idealist, crushes mother, wife, and son under the absolute imperative of 'will'—the purity of the ideal is the purity of the cruelty; Peer, the egoist who holds to no ideal at all, lives by 'going around,' ending up peeling an onion in search of a self and finding no core—together the two plays say idealism and opportunism are one disease: two ways of refusing real encounter with others
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生理想解剖法的核心命题是：理想的道德价值不在其内容而在其'在具体生活中的产出'——一个词越是被无成本地供奉，越需要被带成本地检验。常规批判只处理'坏理想'（揭穿坏人的口号），对'好理想'免检；易卜生把手术刀对准最受欢迎的理想词，分三步。第一步，取样：找到该理想在具体人物身上的'实践形态'（布朗德的'意志'如何对母亲收费、娜拉的'爱'如何在借贷里运作）——样本必须来自生活而非教义。第二步，验产出：追踪理想的实际产出链——它喂养了谁、消耗了谁、在关键时刻兑现为什么（布朗德的'全有'兑现为全家的死亡）；产出与宣言的落差即诊断书。第三步，验反面：同时解剖该理想的放弃者（培尔的'绕开'）——若坚持者与放弃者殊途同归地毁人，则问题不在'坚持与否'而在理想与人真实生活的关系本身。深意有三重。其一，这是对'词的通货膨胀'的对冲：理想词被供奉得越普遍，越脱离产出，越可能成为免检的暴力许可证。其二，它同时解剖'信的人'与'不信的人'，避免了犬儒的自我豁免——犬儒与狂信是同一枚硬币。其三，它发明了现代思想剧：从萧伯纳、布莱希特到当代'概念剧'，'让一个抽象词在人物身上兑现'是标准作业。适用边界：适合已被普遍供奉、且正在产生实际后果的理想词；对尚在生长期、未被滥用的理念（如早期的公共教育理想）解剖宜缓——过早解剖会让萌芽失去保护。现代对应物：概念史与关键词批判（威廉斯《关键词》）、'行胜于言'的审计文化、对公益/环保/科技乌托邦词汇的'产出对账'、政治口号的兑现率研究。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's ideal-dissection method: an ideal's moral worth lies not in its content but in what it produces in concrete living—the more costlessly a word is worshipped, the more it needs to be tested at cost. Conventional critique handles only 'bad ideals' (exposing the villain's slogans) and exempts the good ones; Ibsen turns the scalpel on the most beloved ideal-words, in three steps. First, take the specimen: find the ideal's practiced form in a concrete person (how Brand's 'will' charges his mother, how Nora's 'love' operates inside borrowing)—specimens from life, not doctrine. Second, verify the output: trace the ideal's actual production chain—who it fed, whom it consumed, what it cashed into at the critical moment (Brand's 'all' cashing into his family's deaths); the gap between output and declaration is the diagnosis. Third, verify the negative: dissect the ideal's abandoner too (Peer's 'going around')—if faithful and faithless destroy alike, the fault lies not in persistence but in the ideal's relation to real life. Three layers of depth. First, it hedges 'word inflation': the more universally an ideal-word is enshrined, the more it detaches from output and risks becoming a violence-permit immune from inspection. Second, dissecting both believer and unbeliever spares cynicism its self-exemption—cynic and zealot are one coin. Third, it invented the modern play of ideas—from Shaw and Brecht to today's concept-plays, 'making an abstract word cash out in a character' is standard practice. Boundaries: it fits ideal-words already universally enshrined and actively producing consequences; ideals still young and un-abused (early public-education ideals, say) should be dissected slowly—too early a dissection strips a sprout of protection. Modern counterparts: keyword critique (Raymond Williams's Keywords), audit culture's 'deeds over words,' output-accounting for charity/environment/tech-utopia vocabulary, and fulfillment-rate studies of political slogans.
modes.source_chapter: 《布朗德》(1866) 与《培尔·金特》(1867) 全文；易卜生关于两剧的通信（致比厄恩松等）；萧伯纳《易卜生主义的精华》；雷蒙·威廉斯《关键词》方法论引言（后世的同构发展）
key_concepts: 理想的价值在于产出
供奉成本越低检验成本越高
宣言与产出的落差即诊断
同时解剖信者与弃者
犬儒与狂信是一枚硬币
词的通胀需要产出对账
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个词被供奉得越久，越要问它最近吃掉了谁。
modes.key_quote_en: The longer a word has been enshrined, the harder you must ask whom it has lately consumed.
process_zh: 选供奉词：挑出该语境中被无成本供奉、且正在产生实际后果的理想词（真理/自由/爱/效率）
取样生活：找到该词在具体人物/组织身上的实践形态——样本来自账本、日程与关键时刻，不来自讲稿
对账产出：追踪该理想的产出链——喂养了谁、消耗了谁、危机时刻兑现为什么；落差写成诊断书
解剖弃者：同时追踪'宣布放弃该理想者'的产出——若两途同毁，把问题升维到理想与生活的关系
标注用途边界：写下该词在什么剂量、什么关系里仍然有效——解剖不为取消而为校准
公开留档：把诊断写成可复检的作品/报告——让下一个供奉者开始前先读一遍
process_en: Pick the enshrined word: select the ideal-word worshipped costlessly in this context and actively producing consequences (truth, freedom, love, efficiency)
Specimen from life: find the word's practiced form in a concrete person or organization—from ledgers, calendars, and crisis moments, not speeches
Audit the output: trace the ideal's production chain—whom it fed, whom it consumed, what it cashed into in crisis; write the gap up as diagnosis
Dissect the abandoner: track the output of those who publicly renounced the ideal—if both roads ruin, raise the question to the ideal's relation with life
Mark the working range: write down at what dose and in what relations the word still holds—dissection calibrates, it does not abolish
Archive publicly: turn the diagnosis into a re-checkable work or report—so the next worshipper reads it once before beginning
representative_cases_zh: 《布朗德》的'全有'（1866）：一场瘟疫里拒绝保留三分之一药品的理想纯度——母亲、妻子、儿子依次死于'意志'的利息
《培尔·金特》的剥洋葱（1867）：终老时分在洋葱里找'核心'而只找到一层层'角色皮'——不供奉任何理想者的下场被同样解剖
娜拉的'爱'被对账（1879）：八年'为爱借贷'的产出是伪造的签名与不能对话的婚姻——'爱'这个词在账本上第一次现出原形
易卜生对'民族诗人'头衔的拒斥（1860s-70s）：被祖国同时供奉与围剿——他自己成了被解剖的那个理想词
representative_cases_en: Brand's 'all or nothing' (1866): refusing, amid plague, to keep back a third of the medicine—the purity of the ideal billing mother, wife, and son with compound interest of 'will'
Peer Gynt peeling the onion (1867): in old age seeking a 'core' in an onion and finding only layers of roles—the fate of one who enshrined nothing, dissected with equal rigor
Nora's 'love' audited (1879): eight years of borrowing-for-love producing a forged signature and an unmarriageable silence—the word 'love' showing its true face in a ledger
Ibsen refusing the 'national poet' crown (1860s-70s): worshipped and besieged by his homeland at once—he became the ideal-word under his own dissection
modern_applications_zh: 科技伦理：对'创新''连接世界''免费'等供奉词做产出对账——注意力经济时代的理想词审计表
公益与 ESG：'行胜于言'的兑现率审计——把使命宣言与年度支出、危机时刻的实际选择对账
个人价值观梳理：把自己最信的三个词（如'自由''家庭''成长'）做生活对账——它们去年分别消耗与喂养了什么
组织文化批判：对'奋斗''用户第一''家人'等文化词做危机时刻兑现记录——招聘者与离职者是最好的取样员
modern_applications_en: Tech ethics: output-audits for enshrined words—'innovation,' 'connecting the world,' 'free'—an audit table of ideal-words for the attention economy
Nonprofits and ESG: fulfillment-rate audits of 'deeds over words'—reconciling mission statements with annual spending and crisis-moment choices
Personal values review: life-audit your three most-believed words ('freedom,' 'family,' 'growth')—what each consumed and fed last year
Organizational culture critique: crisis-moment cash-out records for culture words like 'hustle,' 'customer first,' 'family'—recruiters and leavers are the best specimen collectors

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同代同题的价值重估者——'上帝死后一切价值待验'与易卜生'理想词必须产出对账'互为哲学与戏剧的平行工程
representative_figures.relation_en: the contemporary revaluer of values—'after God's death all values await testing' and Ibsen's output-audit of ideal-words as parallel projects in philosophy and drama

representative_figures.relation_zh: 理想解剖的直接继承人——《人与超人》与《卖花女》把'爱情''教养'等供奉词逐一送上英式解剖台
representative_figures.relation_en: the direct heir—Man and Superman and Pygmalion carrying 'love' and 'breeding' one by one onto the English dissecting table

representative_figures.relation_zh: 二十世纪的产出对账员——'我为什么不当基督徒'式演讲与易卜生的取样法同构：教义不如危机时刻的兑现记录
representative_figures.relation_en: the twentieth century's output-auditor—'Why I Am Not a Christian' isomorphic with Ibsen's sampling: doctrine versus cash-out in crisis moments

name_zh: 创作者元方法论/把解剖刀最后转向自己的艺术与自负——每部新作否定前作，晚年自反三部曲审判自己一生的方法；写作者的第一对象是自己
name_en: the creator's meta-methodology/turning the scalpel last upon one's own art and vanity—each new work negating the last, a late self-reckoning trilogy judging one's own lifelong method; the writer's first subject is the writer
category: 创作者元方法论/把解剖刀最后转向自己的艺术与自负——每部新作否定前作，晚年自反三部曲审判自己一生的方法；写作者的第一对象是自己
modes.domain_zh: 1892-1899 自反三部曲：《建筑大师》里索尔尼斯就是易卜生（年轻女崇拜者、对后辈的恐惧、'塔顶花环'的虚荣）；《小艾友夫》审判他一生对家庭的不在场；《当我们死人醒来时》老雕塑家与年轻时以他为模特的女子重逢——'你的艺术偷走了我的生活'。终章的题词近乎遗言：艺术家的成功是以谁的死亡为燃料的。他晚年对友人说：'写作就是站在法官面前自审'——这句话是他全部方法论的最后一行
modes.domain_en: The self-reckoning trilogy of 1892-99: in The Master Builder, Solness is Ibsen—young female worshipper, fear of the young, the vanity of the wreath on the tower; Little Eyolf tries his lifelong absence from family; When We Dead Awaken has the old sculptor meet the woman who once modeled for him—'your art stole my life.' The final chapter's epigraph is nearly a testament: whose deaths fueled the artist's success? He told friends in old age: 'to write is to sit in judgment on oneself'—the last line of his entire methodology
modes.definition_zh: 易卜生自审写作法的核心命题是：批判方法若不最终指向批判者自身，就会退化为免责的权力技术——解剖者的第一具标本必须是自己。常规创作把批判对外（讽刺社会、揭露他人），作者本人隐身于作品之外获得豁免；易卜生的替代路线分三步。第一步，定期否定前作：公开宣称'每部新作否定上一部'——让方法本身不断失去既得利益者地位，作者对自己的旧答案保持可错性。第二步，写作自传性标本：把自己的核心罪状（对家人的冷漠、对崇拜者的依赖、对名望的经营）写进人物——索尔尼斯的恐惧、鲁贝克的 stolen model，都是易卜生案卷的实物证据；自传性不是忏悔录而是证据保全。第三步，判决不给赦免：晚年的自审不导向'我已悔悟'的和解结局——鲁贝克夫妇死于雪崩，判决执行完毕；自审的完成态不是安慰而是清算。深意有三重。其一，这是对'批判者豁免权'的废除：揭露者的私德与动机从此也在作品里受审。其二，它把'可错性'制度化为创作纪律——作者对自己的昨日保持敌意，才配解剖他人的今日。其三，它给创作者的伦理账本留了最后的页码：作品的成功以什么为燃料，这个问题只有作者本人有资格提出并回答。适用边界：适合已有成熟方法、拥有话语权的创作者与批判者；对尚在求生阶段的写作者，自审的剂量需克制——生存期未过，过早自审是自我绞杀。现代对应物：纪录片作者的'反身性'声明（ Reflexivity）、学术写作的利益冲突申报、 programmer 的 post-mortem 包含自己写的 bug、作家晚年自反作品（菲利普·罗斯《退场的幽灵》系列）。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of Ibsen's self-judgment-writing method: a critical method that never finally points at the critic degrades into an exempting technology of power—the dissector's first specimen must be himself. Conventional creation directs critique outward (satirizing society, exposing others) while the author hides outside the work under immunity. Ibsen's route has three steps. First, periodically negate one's own previous work: publicly declare 'each new play negates the last'—keeping the method itself stripped of vested interest, holding one's old answers as falsifiable. Second, write autobiographical specimens: put one's own core charges (coldness to family, dependence on admirers, the management of fame) into characters—Solness's fear and Rubek's stolen model are physical exhibits from Ibsen's own case file; the autobiographical here is not confession but preservation of evidence. Third, grant no absolution: the late self-judgment does not end in the reconciled 'I have repented'—the Rubeks die in the avalanche, sentence executed; the completed form of self-judgment is settlement, not comfort. Three layers of depth. First, it abolishes the critic's immunity: from now on the exposer's private conduct and motives are on trial inside the work. Second, it institutionalizes fallibility as creative discipline—only an author hostile to his own yesterday is fit to dissect others' today. Third, it reserves the final page of the creator's ethical ledger: what fuel did the work's success burn? Only the author has standing to ask and answer. Boundaries: it suits creators and critics with mature methods and discursive power; for writers still in survival mode the dose must be restrained—before survival, premature self-judgment is self-strangulation. Modern counterparts: documentary reflexivity statements, conflict-of-interest declarations in scholarship, post-mortems that include one's own bugs, and late self-reckoning works (Roth's Zuckerman Bound finale).
modes.source_chapter: 《建筑大师》(1892)《小艾友夫》(1894)《当我们死人醒来时》(1899) 全文；易卜生晚年书信与谈话（转引自迈克尔·迈耶《易卜生传》第 27-30 章）；卢·安德烈亚斯-莎乐美《易卜生的群像》；詹姆斯·乔伊斯《易卜生的新戏剧》(1900)
